title: Ogre
description: Folklore record: the man-eating giant of French fairy tales — from 'ogre' of Perrault to Shrek's subversion.

title: Troll
description: Folklore record: the Scandinavian mountain-and-bridge dweller — turned to stone by sunlight.

title: Cyclops
description: Folklore record: the one-eyed giant of Greek myth — Polyphemus, outwitted by Odysseus.

title: Minotaur
description: Folklore record: the bull-headed man of the Cretan labyrinth — slain by Theseus with Ariadne's thread.

title: Hydra
description: Folklore record: the many-headed serpent of Lerna — two heads grow for each one cut.

title: Golem
description: Folklore record: the clay protector of Jewish legend — animated by sacred words, deactivated by erasing them.

title: Sphinx
description: Folklore record: the riddling lion-woman of Thebes — 'what walks on four, two, then three legs?'

title: Manticore
description: Folklore record: the Persian man-eater with a lion's body, a human face, and a scorpion's tail.
